items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: he was working with a group that Babs Gonzalez had at the club where we were working, in the Onyx Club

ctx.x: As a matter of fact, I had no choice.

That was when he got the pianist that he has now, and he's been with him ever since -- his name is Bobby Tucker. A fine pianist and a fine arranger and musician. He and I are good friends. Bobby went with him in early 1948, and has been right there ever since. And it's so funny, Bobby Tucker had been Billie Holiday's pianist. When we used to play on 52nd Street... As a matter of fact, the last time we played 52nd Street, he was not with Billie Holiday. He was working with a group that Babs Gonzalez had at the…

Accompanying a singer is fine, but the only thing about it, when you're working accompanying a singer, you never really get a chance to play, other than just the accompaniment that you do. When we came on, Billy was introduced and I accompanied him, and that was all the playing I would do. So whenever I wanted to play, I would have to go sit in with somebody.
